decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 8.00am - 10.30pm daily.

Condition : 3 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the launderette shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced, details of the shopfront design shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE
The applicant is reminded that any new signs to the shopfront may require separate advertisement consent.
description: Change of use from A1 (retail)  to Launderette (Sui Generis).
